scope: Compare existing ready models on identical frozen corpora without training, model tuning or product integration

models.gigastt: Existing standard ml_ctc_large INT8 baseline; no language hint
models.whisper: Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3 pinned edaa852ec7e145841d8ffdb056a99866b5f0a478; CPU INT8, beam5, temperature0, known kk/uz, no previous-text conditioning, VAD off; native no-speech gate retained
models.omni: Official omniASR_CTC_1B_v2 FP32, official greedy CTC, no language hint, no external language model

inference: Three CPU compute threads and one inference worker per candidate; complete original file, native fixed model preprocessing/chunking. FFmpeg float32 mono16k adapter input; no external filters or PCM16 requantization.
primary: Same single supplied human reference, Unicode normalized micro WER/CER, failed requests retained as empty, all original rows including duplicates. No transliteration, alternate-reference minimum or outcome-based subset selection.
timing: Quality-run latencies are not speed benchmarks. Separate fixed20-row resource sample, first5 per corpus, sixth warmup;2reverse model-order rounds;fresh process per model/corpus/round, single sequential request. Unrelated user workloads are not stopped; results potentially contended.
limitations: Kyrgyz corpus is read speech, not conversation.
Kazakh natural conversation is887 short human-segmented units from4recordings.
Model families, native frontends, precision and known-language inputs differ; this compares deployable configurations, not architecture alone.
Public model training overlap with these evaluation corpora is unknown.

quality_execution_amendment.when: Before any candidate quality evaluation; after preparatory single-instance timing
quality_execution_amendment.reason: Short-utterance Whisper CPU cost makes serial full-corpus evaluation slow
quality_execution_amendment.unchanged: Weights, decoder configuration, audio, references, selection and single-instance resource measurements
quality_execution_amendment.durability: One source-order ledger; failed outputs retained; candidate models have no cross-recording context
